title: Safe in Egypt
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: After the wise men left, an angel came to Joseph in a dream. “Get up! Take the child and His mother to Egypt. King Herod wants to hurt Him.”
Egypt was a land far away. Joseph did not wait until morning. He left that very night with Mary and Jesus.
They stayed in Egypt, safe and sound, until King Herod died.
p2: Then the angel came again. “It is safe now. Go home.” So Joseph brought his family back to Nazareth, where Jesus would grow up.
Joseph obeyed right away, and Heavenly Father kept Jesus safe. Tonight, when Mom or Dad asks you to do something, obey right away.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
